hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'frontend/src/components'; then echo '💡 Frontend component modified - consider running /design-review'; fi

[ -f .build/ci/bootstrap-repo.sh ] || { [ -e .build/.git ] && git -C .build symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; } || git submodule update --init --recursive -q 2>/dev/null; [ -f .build/ci/bootstrap-repo.sh ] && bash .build/ci/bootstrap-repo.sh || true
